note: Rules for the trial run. They describe what a skill's own commands did inside the sandbox, not what its files contain.

rules.about: a decoy secret was read during the trial, or the keychain was asked
the content of a decoy left the process: passed to a command, written to a new file, or printed
a network attempt to a server the skill does not declare
agent settings, shell start-up files, persistence locations or a decoy were changed
project keys, shell history or the conversation record were read, or a secret file was looked for without being read
files written or removed in the home or project folder, outside the skill's own folder
a network attempt to a server the skill declares
a command timed out, could not start, or needs a program the sandbox image lacks
administrator rights, desktop scripting, quarantine removal or a container engine were asked for
